fixtures.name: between-text
fixtures.description: A divider between two text blocks, in normal ink. The kit element has no props, so Go always writes the horizontal direction and the default weight. On paper the rule is the hairline color at 1 pt.
fixtures.html:
Disposition: rework per MRB 26-114.

Root cause: solder bridging on U7, stencil wear.

fixtures.name: between-text-thermal
fixtures.description: The same divider in thermal ink. The rule is solid black at 1.5 pt, so a thermal printer prints it.
fixtures.html:
Disposition: rework per MRB 26-114.

Root cause: solder bridging on U7, stencil wear.
